FAQ

Common questions

Can ABiT customize ERPNext?

Yes. ABiT customizes ERPNext with custom fields, doctypes, workflows, print formats, dashboards, reports and integrations.

Do you support ERPNext hosting?

Yes. ABiT can support managed hosting, backups, monitoring and performance work for ERPNext deployments.

Which teams fit ERPNext best?

ERPNext can fit growing teams that need accounting, stock, sales, purchasing, manufacturing, HR and project workflows with strong customization flexibility.
